**Implementation note:** Quote models; the platform's grid is the buy-side, long-only relative.

## Description

Places bid and ask limit orders at configurable distances from mid-price and refreshes quotes as time or price thresholds are reached.

## Where it may fit

Deep, orderly markets with reliable two-sided flow and spreads wider than adverse-selection plus operating costs.

## Vehicles

Crypto spot market makers and electronic liquidity providers.

## Required data

Level-2 order book or best bid/ask, trades, mid-price, inventory, order-age and fill data, maker fees/rebates.

## Caveats

Without inventory/adverse-selection controls, spread capture may be negative after toxic fills and price trends.
